name: chart-story
description: One chart builds from data in reading order and lands the exact supplied values: staggered bars, a left-to-right line with area fill, a sweeping donut, or filling progress bars, with an accented value callout on the emphasized datum.

vars.description: Chart form the data builds into.
Comma-separated numbers; the chart lands exactly on these values.
Index of the datum that takes the accent and the value callout. Clamped to the data range.
Suffix appended to every displayed value.
Contract color used by the emphasized datum and its callout.
Optional departure. Proof stats end on the still hold, so the default is none.
